post_call_analysis_data.name: coverage_satisfaction
post_call_analysis_data.description:
Find out whether the client is satisfied with their coverage or not.

If they say "yes", it means they are satisfied.

If they say any of these, it means they are dissatisfied:
- "I'm not sure what I have"
- "I think my coverage is too low"
- "I feel like I'm paying for too much"
- Any uncertainty about coverage

post_call_analysis_data.name: coverage_dissatisfaction_reason
post_call_analysis_data.description: Find out the reason why the client is dissatisfied with their coverage

post_call_analysis_data.name: qualification_result
post_call_analysis_data.description:
Find out if the client needs a review or it's an auto-renewal.

If a client answers "yes" to any of the qualification questions, they need a review.

If a client answers "no" to both qualification questions, they are opting for auto-renewal

If a client does not answer both qualification questions, say the information is "Not Available"

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: Find out if the user booked an appointment after qualifying for a review

post_call_analysis_data.name: secondary_email
post_call_analysis_data.description: This is the email a client provides for booking if they say that the email we have is no longer the right one to use
